title: Cold rebuild: flip a feature flag safely
summary: Change three nested values in appsettings.json without flattening anything, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *JSON and CSV without surprises* you changed a nested config without losing anything. Do it again from memory:
same file, **no hints, no solution**, the same checks. This check and the boss prove the module.

steps.prompt: Without `-Depth`, how many levels of nesting does `ConvertTo-Json` write before it turns objects into text?
steps.explain: The default depth is 2; the maximum is 100. PowerShell 7 warns when it truncates, Windows PowerShell 5.1 does not.

steps.title: Flip a feature flag, cold
prompt: `true` and `Features.Checkout.NewFlow.Rollout.Percent` to `50`. Everything else must survive, including the deep
From memory: no hints this time.
